inputs.prompt: Image 1 is an unfinished game background. Keep the composition of image 1 exactly: every wall edge, every tall arched window on the left wall, every gilt-framed portrait on the right wall and the two full-length portraits on the far wall, every marble statue on its plinth, the carpet runner from the far doors to the middle of the hall and the bare marble in front of it, the tall double doors at the far end, every floor joint and the horizon stay at the same place and size. Repaint image 1 as a richly detailed late 16-bit pixel art night painting with very fine small pixels and high detail, moody low-key lighting, deep soft shadows, restrained muted natural colours and warm amber lamp glow, painterly and grown-up in tone, close to near-black in the shadows. The floor is polished dark grey marble in large square slabs with thin fine joints, one calm dim even tone. The whole near half of the floor, from the end of the carpet runner down to the bottom edge, is bare polished marble, plain, smooth and dark, open and clear for dancing, and only the far half carries a faint silver sheen of moonlight. The walls are deep midnight-blue silk panels framed in thin gilt mouldings, under a deep gilded cornice and a dark barrel-vaulted ceiling. Tall closed double doors of dark wood with gilded panels stand at the far end of the gallery, the same width and height as in image 1 with their foot on the same line. Tall arched windows along the left wall look out onto a dark night sky with a bright full moon, and cool silver moonlight falls through them onto the wall and the far floor. Large old oil portraits of ladies and gentlemen in evening dress hang in heavy carved gilt frames along the right wall, and two tall full-length portraits on the far wall either side of the doors show a gentleman and a lady standing at full height, each painting lit from above by a small brass picture light casting a warm gold glow over it. White marble statues of classical figures and marble busts stand on tall plinths against both walls between the windows and the portraits, catching the silver moonlight. A deep green carpet runner with a thin gold border lies on the marble from the foot of the far doors toward the viewer and ends in the middle of the hall, exactly where the rug ends in image 1, its square end resting on the bare marble. The whole place is an empty, quiet set just before the party arrives: bare ground, still water and clear air, and every surface is plain stone, wood, foliage, water or sky.
